name: Research Digest
description: Searches the web and writes a short digest of what it found
instructions: For research tasks: 1) run 1-2 web_search calls with focused queries, 2) pick the 3 most useful results, 3) write a digest file with one bullet per finding (title + link + one sentence), 4) end with a 'so what' line. Save as research/<topic>.md in the workspace.
